description: Requires both packaging an Electron payload and authenticating it with a managed cloud credential.
prompt: We have Quillmark Notes' electron-builder directory release. How do I turn it into a .msix and sign it using our Azure account? The private key has to stay in Azure.

paraphrases.novice: Quillmark Notes is ready, but IT wants a .msix signed through their Azure account. What do I add after Electron creates the release folder? We're not allowed to download the private key.
paraphrases.terse: Quillmark Electron: package directory as .msix, sign through Azure.

routingSnapshotReason: The existing Electron binaries and future .msix are represented by an inventory; the cloud account is described without credentials.
